ul.li: update stack limit if stack limit fault is enabled
go to each table after this one in "growable table area" and update table pointers by adding grow size
move everything after this table by grow size
zero-init new elements of the table
Move blocks from "one memory program movable content" to its right position (starting from the last one)
Clear source of each moved word (after reading it and before writing it)
Active if maximum program memory size is provided and it is <= 32K
All jumps addresses (relative and absolute) are 16-bit long.
Jump instructions max size is 3 bytes
Jump addresses (e.g. in tables) are 2-bytes long
Fixed size internal read-only wasm table can have 16-bit elements
if data memory is provided and it is <= 64K
some pointers or sizes may be reduced to 16-bits, e.g. pointer to table pointer, size/offset in memory init table
